messages:
Maya (People Ops): FYI — rolling out a short-term family support PTO top-up for adoption and foster placements + a streamlined international travel per-diem submission flow. Quick summary below and an FAQ link: https://redwood.internal/hr/family-topup :tada:

Avery (Eng): timeline?

Maya (People Ops): Effective 2026-04-15 for new placements, retroactive coverage available for placements since 2026-01-01. Top-up: up to 4 weeks paid at your normal pay rate, used in addition to standard parental leave. Eligibility: full-time employees and contractors with 6+ months tenure. :memo:

Samir (Finance): How do folks claim the top-up? receipts?

Maya (People Ops): Claim via the new expense category below and submit supporting docs (placement letter). Finance will auto-process within 10 business days. Travel per-diem change: international per-diem now uses automated receipts — no manual per-diem form. Use expense code `EXP-INTRNL-PERD` for allowances and `FAM-TOPUP` for the top-up reimbursement. Example command/snippet for Concur upload:

```
Expense Category: FAM-TOPUP
Amount: <enter amount>
Attach: placement_letter.pdf (required)
Submit to: PeopleOps > Family Top-up queue
```

Lina (IC): Is PTO banked or separate days? Can it be split?

Maya (People Ops): It's a top-up payment (not additional PTO days) that can be taken as either continuous paid leave or split across time within 6 months of placement. If you want actual PTO days instead, talk to your manager — we'll evaluate case-by-case.

Jon (Manager): Manager approval required?

Maya (People Ops): Managers sign off to confirm operational coverage. Approvals are via the HR workflow linked in the FAQ. No additional manager paperwork beyond the approval step.

Emma (People Ops): Quick note on travel: for conferences and client travel, the new per-diem auto-receipt flow starts now. If you travel before 2026-04-15 and need retro per-diem, use the legacy code `EXP-LEGACY-PERD`. After 04/15, please use `EXP-INTRNL-PERD`.

Kai (IC): Any tax implications?

Samir (Finance): The top-up is payroll-processed and taxed per local rules; we add a line in paystubs labeled "Family Support Top-up". If you have questions about withholding, ping payroll.

Ava (People Ops): We also updated the Code of Conduct language around travel behavior and vendor engagements — short reminder: be mindful of client boundaries, respect local laws, and file any incident reports via the security/reporting form. FAQ link has the excerpt. :information_source:

hr-bot: Reminder — policy doc updated: https://redwood.internal/hr/family-topup (view-only link).

Maya (People Ops): We'll host two drop-in office hours this week for questions (Wed 10am PT, Thu 4pm PT). If you need 1:1 help or an expedited review for an imminent placement, DM me or book via the People Ops calendar. :calendar:

Avery (Eng): Thanks — appreciate the clarity. :thumbsup:

Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone — filing the official memo now. If you spot anything unclear in the FAQ, flag it here and we'll update. :sparkles:
